question: Can you find 5 delivery drivers with the highest average number of daily deliveries?
sql:
SELECT 
    driver_id,
    AVG(daily_count) as avg_daily_deliveries
FROM (
    SELECT 
        dd.driver_id,
        o.order_created_month,
        o.order_created_day,
        COUNT(*) as daily_count
    FROM deliveries dd
    JOIN orders o ON dd.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
    GROUP BY dd.driver_id, o.order_created_month, o.order_created_day
) as daily_counts
GROUP BY driver_id
ORDER BY avg_daily_deliveries DESC
LIMIT 5
